To facilitate API payments within ChatGPT using MCP, several solutions have been developed:

1. **MCPay**: An open-source infrastructure that adds on-chain payments to any MCP server using the x402 "Payment Required" protocol. It enables clients to make pay-per-call requests, allowing AI agents and applications to pay only for what they use, automatically and transparently. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))
